name: lennox-s40
description: Control a Lennox S40 (and S30/E30 LAN) smart thermostat over the local network: read status, set mode/setpoints/fan/away. Use when the user mentions home AC, heat, thermostat, Lennox Home, S40 zones, or HVAC setpoints. Local HTTPS only (no Lennox cloud). Requires LAN reachability and one-time scripts/lennox-s40 --setup.
